children: On August 6, 2026, Papa John's reported an 8.3% decline in North American comparable sales and announced the suspension of its quarterly dividend beginning in the third quarter of 2026. Papa John's also sharply reduced its full-year outlook, projecting a 6% to 8% decline in North American comparable sales, compared with its previous projection of a 2% to 4% decline.
Following this news, the price of Papa John's stock fell $5.11 per share, or approximately 17.18%, to close at $24.64 per share on August 6, 2026.

During the earnings call that same day, management acknowledged that its transformation was taking more time than anticipated and required faster, better execution. Management also admitted that its product innovation efforts were attracting fewer new customers than expected. These disclosures followed prior assurances that its turnaround strategy was working and that its 2026 outlook reflected a prudent and realistic forecast.
